changelog:
- Initial release of primer-chutes for x402.
- Enables creation of a pay-per-inference proxy for Bittensor Chutes AI (Subnet 64).
- Accepts USDC payments on Base, forwarding requests to the decentralized Chutes AI network.
- Provides scaffolding and deployment instructions for Node.js/TypeScript and Python.
- Supports flexible pricing, model selection, and cloud deployment.
- Ideal for monetizing AI endpoints and integrating crypto payments for AI services.
summary: Build a pay-per-inference proxy for Bittensor Chutes AI. Accept USDC payments for decentralized AI inference using x402.
